text: The seven story masters are listed at the Markdown version and their workbooks at the last workbook version; the two are not presented as one pair.
why: The workbooks were not regenerated in this run and no lower version is invented.
impact: A reader who takes the workbook as current reads the previous release structure.

text: Where a family holds two formats at two versions, each file is listed with its own version and neither is renamed.
why: Only one format was rebuilt in several work packages; renaming would break the version rules of R8.2.
applied_in: Document index v14, the Files column of the affected rows
impact: The reader must open both formats to see the whole document.

text: Folders are named as the current version of the specifications and the physical schema; no archive is invented.
why: The realignment produced folders, and R8.2 says the next version sits next to the old one.
impact: A reader expecting one archive must use the folder.

text: API Specification v5 is listed as the folder of yaml and AsyncAPI files, and v4.html is named as the previous rendering.
why: No v5 HTML exists and the v4 rendering is the only one.
impact: The reader opens the yaml files rather than a single page.

text: Entity Relationship Diagram v6.md is listed as the current diagram; the v5 renderings are not presented as current.
why: The Markdown is the only file written at v6.
impact: No PDF or HTML of v6 is available.

text: The realignment tracker is listed at v1.
why: It is the only tracker in folder 22.

text: No Run Summary is listed because no such file exists in folder 22.
why: The index lists files that exist and never invents one.
impact: The run material list is one item shorter than R8.3 names.

text: Documents that no realignment work package touched are listed at the version they hold, with no claim that they match the target.
why: The index records the files; it does not rule on their content.
applied_in: Document index v14, Experience section and the other unchanged rows
impact: A reader cannot tell from the index alone whether an untouched document is still accurate.

text: Both project hub files are listed with their folder, and v17 in folder 14 is given as the highest version.
why: Two files carry v15 and neither can be renamed by this work package.
impact: A reader following v15 may open the wrong hub.

text: The BRD for Epics 3 to 8 and the 20 PRDs are recorded at v1 with status Draft, and the index continues without an approval.
why: The source documents are Draft; the run proceeds without a human approval stop (U8) and the index does not block on a status.
read: 03 Requirements and specifications/Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Epics 3 to 8 v1.md and the PRD folder
impact: The requirements set may change before sign-off, and the index would then need a new version.

text: Every version number in this index is the highest version found under that document name in its folder on 22 November 2026.
why: The index must show the current file and must not renumber files.
applied_in: Document index v14, all Files cells
impact: A file added after this version is not in the index until the next version.
